name: Eskinita
storyline:
ESKINITA is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.

The horror in ESKINITA doesn’t rely on constant threats, but on the slow realization that your routine is no longer safe, and your journey home is no longer predictable.

Each night pushes you further into uncertainty, where something unseen seems to observe your movement through the alleys.

You close the lugawan the same way every night. Wash the bowls. Wipe the tables. Close the stall. Walk home. The alleyways are always dark, narrow, and quiet at this hour — but lately, something feels wrong.

Customers whisper about strange people roaming at night. The late-night news keeps reporting incidents nearby. At first, its only little things, then one night… they start following you.
summary: Eskinita is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.
